title: Learned blood-omics factors track Rett syndrome status and severity in a small cohort
summary: Unsupervised integration of four blood-omics measurements identified a disease-associated molecular factor and a second factor correlated with clinical severity in nine people with Rett syndrome and eight controls. The learned factors connect measurements across molecular layers, but remain exploratory within-cohort associations. They are not validated diagnostic tests, causal disease mechanisms or demonstrated treatment-response markers.
organization: University of Sydney; Children’s Hospital at Westmead; Macquarie University; Translational Genomics Research Institute; Baylor College of Medicine; Emory University

evidence.tested: Four matched molecular-data layers from nine Rett syndrome participants and eight controls were integrated using MOFA2 latent-factor learning. The main computational Methods specify normalized inputs, participant-identifier joins and associations between factor scores and clinical severity. Factor 1 separated the sampled clinical groups; Factor 2 correlated with severity among the nine affected participants, with reported Spearman rho 0.77 and nominal p 0.016.
evidence.unknown: Seventeen people and nine severity observations are too few to establish generalizable biomarker performance. Factor selection and severity association used the same cohort, without held-out diagnostic evaluation or demonstrated multiplicity-adjusted confirmation of the severity result. Age, cell composition, medication, diet and systemic physiology may influence molecular profiles; peripheral blood does not directly establish brain mechanisms. Orthogonal measurement of an individual metabolite does not independently validate the learned latent factors. No longitudinal response-to-treatment or causal effect was tested.
evidence.ai_role: MOFA2 learned shared variation across transcript, protein, phosphorylation and metabolite measurements, enabling the represented cross-layer disease and severity-associated factor analysis beyond separate differential-expression tests.

source_review.scope: Read primary cohort/reference metadata, computational normalization/integration/MOFA2 factor and severity-association Methods, corresponding factor Results and clinical/confounding limitations. No laboratory procedures were independently adjudicated. Individual metabolite confirmation is not counted as independent latent-model validation. Exact original article front DOI/title and fresh PubMed primary relationship metadata checked.
